description: Find and read your Highspot sales content: spots, items, search, users, groups and pitches, and start workflows when content is added or changed in a spot.

highspot_item_updated_trigger.description: Runs for each item added or changed in a spot in Highspot. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 1,000 items in the spot. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.author: Who added the item.
output.content_name: The file name of the item's content.
output.content_type: The kind of content, such as PDF, Video or WebLink.
output.item: The whole item as Highspot gives it.
output.spot_id: The id of the spot the item is in.
output.title: The item's title.

parameters.description: The spot to watch.
parameters.name: spot_id

highspot_new_group_trigger.description: Runs for each new group in Highspot. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 1,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.group: The whole group as Highspot gives it.
output.name: The group's name.

highspot_new_item_trigger.description: Runs for each new item added to a spot in Highspot. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 1,000 items in the spot. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.author: Who added the item.
output.content_name: The file name of the item's content.
output.content_type: The kind of content, such as PDF, Video or WebLink.
output.item: The whole item as Highspot gives it.
output.spot_id: The id of the spot the item is in.
output.title: The item's title.

parameters.description: The spot to watch.
parameters.name: spot_id

highspot_new_pitch_trigger.description: Runs for each new pitch the user who made the API key sends in Highspot. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The pitch's title.
output.pitch: The whole pitch as Highspot gives it.

highspot_new_search_match_trigger.description: Runs for each new item in Highspot that matches a search, in any spot you can view. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.author: Who added the item.
output.content_name: The file name of the item's content.
output.content_type: The kind of content, such as PDF, Video or WebLink.
output.item: The whole item as Highspot gives it.
output.spot_id: The id of the spot the item is in.
output.title: The item's title.

parameters.description: The words to search for, as in Highspot's search box.
parameters.name: query

highspot_new_spot_trigger.description: Runs for each new spot in Highspot. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 1,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The spot's id, for 'Get spot' and 'List items'.
output.name: The spot's title.
output.spot: The whole spot as Highspot gives it.

highspot_new_user_trigger.description: Runs for each new user in Highspot. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 1,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The user's name, or their email when Highspot gives no name.
output.user: The whole user as Highspot gives it.
